svg.title: NIDS pipeline: React dashboard, FastAPI orchestrator, then the CICFlowMeter, preprocessing, model (2D CNN with OpenMax) and decision engine services
svg.desc: Top to bottom: the React dashboard sends a PCAP capture to the FastAPI orchestrator and shows the verdict it returns. The orchestrator calls each service in turn: CICFlowMeter turns the PCAP into flow features, the preprocessing service cleans and scales them, the model service classifies the flows with a 2D CNN and OpenMax, and the decision engine assigns a severity verdict and alerts.
